 WSL fixtures this weekend: TV channels and free streams
 WSL football continues this weekend with Chelsea against Manchester City on BBC One, and every other fixture listed by Sky Sports. Two matches are also available on the…
 By James Chettle Verified Human Published 13 Nov 2026, 20:39 Live for 18 hours Read me this article 2 min G Add as preferred source 
 WSL football continues this weekend with Chelsea against Manchester City on BBC One, and every other fixture listed by Sky Sports. Two matches are also available on the league’s official YouTube channel.
 There are seven games across Saturday 14 and Sunday 15 November. Manchester United open the programme against Crystal Palace , and Arsenal ’s meeting with London City Lionesses brings the weekend to a close.
 WSL fixtures this weekend: UK TV schedule
 All times below are GMT kick-off times. Pre-match programmes may begin earlier.
 Date and kick-off Match Venue UK coverage 
 Sat 14 Nov, 12.45pm Man Utd vs Crystal Palace Progress with Unity Stadium Sky Sports Premier League 
 Sat 14 Nov, 1.30pm Chelsea vs Man City Stamford Bridge BBC One 
 Sat 14 Nov, 3pm Tottenham vs Everton BetWright Stadium Sky Sports Premier League 
 Sat 14 Nov, 5.15pm Brighton vs Liverpool Amex Stadium Sky Sports Premier League; WSL YouTube 
 Sun 15 Nov, 2pm Aston Villa vs Birmingham Villa Park Sky Sports Premier League 
 Sun 15 Nov, 2pm West Ham vs Charlton Victoria Road Stadium Sky Sports Mix; WSL YouTube 
 Sun 15 Nov, 4.30pm Arsenal vs London City Lionesses Emirates Stadium Sky Sports Premier League 
 The channel information follows Sky’s listings and the WSL’s official broadcast announcement . Chelsea vs City is the BBC selection.
 Which WSL games are on YouTube?
 Brighton against Liverpool on Saturday and West Ham against Charlton on Sunday are the two games on the official WSL YouTube channel. UK viewers can watch those streams without a Sky Sports subscription.
 The YouTube listings apply only to these two games. They do not mean all seven fixtures are available there.
 When should I tune in for Arsenal?
 Arsenal against London City Lionesses kicks off at 4.30pm on Sunday. Sky Sports Premier League starts its programme at 4.15pm. Sky currently lists Main Event coverage from 5pm, so choose Premier League if you want the start of the match.
 Which matches overlap?
 Saturday’s first two games overlap, with Chelsea vs City starting 45 minutes after United vs Palace. On Sunday, Villa vs Birmingham and West Ham vs Charlton both start at 2pm.
 That gives viewers a choice of games rather than a continuous run of seven complete live broadcasts. For previews, team news and reaction, follow our football coverage .
